w:r.w:t: Here’s a breakdown of each (with what it covers and why it’s helpful):
Catu General PPE Combination Kit: A comprehensive kit containing multiple items (helmets, boots, gloves etc) all
in one. Good for outfitting a new team or site.
Milwaukee General Personal Protection Kit: Premium set of personal protection gear (gloves, perhaps ear/eye protection) — for tasks with higher hazard.
Work Combo Deal: Economy combo deal for standard site workers — could be cost
efficient for your 10 permanent employees plus additional site staff.
Overall 2Pc Reflective Royal Blue: Work suit/overall with reflective tape — adds clothing + visibility component.
Beck Rainsuit Reflective Tape Rubberised: Waterproof rain suit with reflectivity — great for exterior work in wet weather; ideal for your infrastructure/maintenance projects.
Tyvek Hooded Coveralls (Dupont): Coverall suit for dust/chemical protection — relevant when you’re doing refurbishment or working with materials that produce dust or require cleaning.
visibility work suit (e.g., orange/navy) — ideal for your construction crews especially around moving machinery or traffic.
Toe Work Boots: Essential foot protection for all site workers — steel
toe boots recommended for construction, puncture/slip resistant.
PPE selection should match the hazards on your sites (fall risk, dust, chemical, machinery, traffic) as per safety guidance.
vis, rainsuits) are indeed part of PPE.
Make sure each item is certified (SANS/ISO) for South African construction site use.
Fit, comfort and suitability matter — poor fit = reduced protection.
